scenes.context: 关掉顶灯避免熊猫眼，打开窗户利用窗光，用窗帘柔化直射光。
sentences: 第一步关掉顶灯。
First, turn off the overhead light.
overhead light（顶灯）
顶灯会制造熊猫眼和难看的阴影。
It creates panda eyes and ugly shadows.
panda eyes（熊猫眼）
利用窗户这块巨大的免费光源。
Use the window as a huge free light source.
free light source（免费光源）
用窗帘融化一下光线。
Soften the light with a curtain.
curtain（窗帘）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达顶灯问题
Ceiling lights cast harsh shadows under your eyes.
换种说法表达窗帘柔光
Let a curtain soften the window light.
scenes.speak: First, turn off the overhead light. It creates panda eyes and ugly shadows. Use the window as a huge free light source, and soften the light with a curtain.

scenes.title_en: Tidy the Background and Add a Bounce
scenes.context: 找对称构图收拾背景留性格小物；脸阴影重时用反光板补光。
sentences: 找一个相对好看的背景。
Find a background that looks decent.
decent（还不错的）
留一些有性格的小东西。
Keep a few items with personality.
personality（个性）
将反光板放在脸的阴影侧。
Put the bounce board on the shadowed side.
shadowed side（阴影侧）
通过不断调试找到适合自己的角度。
Adjust it until you find the right angle.
adjust（调整）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达背景收拾
Clean up and keep a few characterful objects.
换种说法表达反光板调试
Tweak the reflector's angle until your face looks even.
scenes.speak: Find a background that looks decent. Keep a few items with personality. Put the bounce board on the shadowed side and adjust it until you find the right angle.

scenes.context: 买面光灯拉窗帘隔绝杂光，加氛围灯让背景自然，面光放斜上方。
sentences: 买一个面光灯回来。
Buy a key light.
key light（面光灯）
拉上窗帘隔绝一切没有必要的光线。
Close the curtains to block stray light.
stray light（杂光）
将面光放在斜上方的位置。
Place the key light at a high angle.
high angle（斜上方）
这样你就可以获得一个不错的效果了。
That gives you a solid result.
solid（不错的）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达隔绝杂光
Shut out all unwanted light with the curtains.
换种说法表达面光位置
Angle the light down from above for a natural look.
scenes.speak: Buy a key light and close the curtains to block stray light. Place the key light at a high angle, and that gives you a solid result.

scenes.context: 加两个口袋灯：正后方打立体，正上方打发丝与轮廓分离背景。
sentences: 再买两个口袋灯回来。
Add two pocket lights.
pocket light（口袋灯）
一个放在正后方的位置。
Put one directly behind you.
behind（后方）
让我们主体看起来更加的立体。
It makes the subject look more dimensional.
dimensional（立体的）
让我们的发丝与背部轮廓和背景分离开来。
It separates your hair and silhouette from the background.
separate（分离）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达后光作用
A light behind adds depth to your subject.
换种说法表达轮廓分离
A top light pulls your hair away from the backdrop.
scenes.speak: Add two pocket lights. Put one directly behind you to make the subject look more dimensional, and one above to separate your hair and silhouette from the background.
